name: Ceres
source:
[i]"Dear God... I... I have killed so many people..."[/i]

[i]Parting from her fate to kill.[/i]

The game's heroine. She has been an orphan for as long as she can remember. Those around her tend to experience sudden accidents or death, so she is shunned by everyone as "Death." After a life of misery, she attempts suicide just before encountering Ankou, who leads her to face the mysterious deaths she has sought to avoid.

[b]Occupation:[/b] Orphanage helper

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/vircheevermore/characters/]Aksys Games[/url]]
